notes.title: Lite updated with all the cool features
notes.content:
Hey guys,

As we announced before, the full release of the game just received the biggest update ever, containing loots of goodies.

Good news is, we didn't forget about the Lite version! It just received a major upgrade, so the gameplay experience is now much more consistent in both full release and Lite.

Feel free to take a look at the previous news post to get the full breakdown of the features list, which include new campaign structure, 16 weapons in total, new enemy designs, ammo management and weapon drop system.

notes.title: Regenesis Arcade Full Release is here!!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30054643/dbe6f6bd0777f45d6b725efec2d5986d9d2cd95b.png[/img]

Hey everybody! I wanted to let you know that the full release version of Regenesis Arcade is available on Steam now!

Thank you for being part of the Regenesis Arcade community! We are glad you enjoyed playing "Lite" version and we wanted to share with you features of the full release Regenesis Arcade!

So the full release version has:
-8 playable maps
-14 weapons
-new enemy types
-weapon drop & ammo systems
-9 new power-ups
-price permanently reduced to $7.99 (available with -15% launch weekend discount!)

... and countless bugfixes and optimization improvements.

You can check out the video about some of the new features, including new map design, below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C6EFoti86LA

If you like the final direction we took with Regenesis Arcade, then join us on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/753370/Regenesis_Arcade/

notes.title: Regenesis Arcade full release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30054643/6859440a8fa956c943a50e734ed4e2678587d8b4.jpg[/img]

Most important numbers regarding Regenesis Arcade:

-September 7th, 2018- the brand new Regenesis Arcade comes out

-$7.99- the permanent price reduction

-13 weapons- bringing diversity to weapons, including some sweet heavy weapons!

-8 maps: brand new ones and old ones, redesigned for the most stunning experience

-2 locomotion modes: teleport and free movement

More perks and redesigned gameplay.

Join us on our mission to save Earth, and we will see you at the top of the highscores, soon!

notes.title: Deluxe Version: New Year, New Update!
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

All the dust has settled down and looks like you all like the game. Don't be shy then, feel free to post a comment and a review on the store page, it will help us a lot! On the other hand, if you found any bugs or issues, make sure to post it on the forums.

With this update come several fixes and changes in DELUXE VERSION:

FEATURE: we added special spawner in front of player starting location that will spawn powerup, barrel or exploding barrel on beginning of every wave.
CRITICAL FIX: different boss types will now appear properly, as most of the time it was the same guy over and over.
MINOR FIXES:
- double damage works now properly with railgun,
- Piercing Shots perk will actually pierce targets now,
- level music will now properly reset after the boss fight,
- drones will not crash into one another so often,
- rebalanced point systems.

Happy new year!

notes.title: First steps: First update and DELUXE version announcement
notes.content:
Hello,

We are really pleased with your warm responses and all the insights into how we can make the game even better. It feels great to release first game in atmosphere of such enthusiasm. We feel honored!

Thanks to all of your amazing feedback, we prepared an important update on game flow and rebalanced few values to enhance the experience. Those are all listed below, but before that we have important information about the Regenesis Arcade DELUXE version, which is much more expanded and packed with content.

We decided to push the Regenesis Arcade DELUXE release date to 18th of December.

It wasn't easy for us, as we feel very excited about releasing our most polished product and we are eager to hear your feedback on how can we improve it. However, different factors, including our perfectionism, made us wait just a few days more, so that all the right features are perfectly balanced. Let us assure you those few days more will be worth it!

Most important changes in this Lite update:
- replaced tutorial wave shooting section with cut right to the Arcade Mode, so that proper gameplay can be experienced much faster than before,
- increased gravity gun range for better game feel and usability,
- rebalanced waves and enemy values to enhance the experience,
- fixed different issues regarding physics.

Once again, thank you for your input and keep your eyes open for DELUXE version!

Hyperbook Studio
